name: develop-with-worktrees
description: A host-neutral Git safety lifecycle for isolated worktrees, task anchors, validation, candidates, and explicit local integration.

interface.shortDescription: Safe Git worktrees, verified candidates, and explicit local integration.
interface.longDescription: Route repository lifecycle ownership, isolate modifying tasks, keep a local task anchor, validate exact candidates, and integrate locally without remote side effects. Optional batched mode publishes immutable candidates into a bounded pool and moves the base only after an explicit seal and combined validation. Native host task/subagent tools own task orchestration; Codex hooks are optional hardening rather than a correctness dependency.
defaultPrompt: Use $develop-with-worktrees to route and safely complete this Git change.
Use $develop-with-worktrees to publish verified candidates and explicitly seal their integration batch.
